title: Cart total only reflects first item price
description: When multiple items are added to the cart, the total displays only the first item price instead of the sum of all items.

defect.fixedContent: total: () => get().items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity, 0),

diagnosis: The total method in cartStore only accesses the first item's price at index 0 rather than reducing over all items and multiplying price by quantity.

title: Adding an existing item does not increment its quantity
description: Adding the same product multiple times leaves the quantity at 1 instead of incrementing it.
diagnosis: The addItem method resets quantity to 1 when a matching existing item is found instead of incrementing quantity by 1.

title: Removing an item retains the item or clears entire cart
description: Calling removeItem with a productId fails to filter out the target product correctly.
diagnosis: The removeItem filter predicate checks i.id === productId instead of i.id !== productId, retaining only the removed product.

title: Clear cart leaves items in state
description: Calling clearCart does not empty the items array completely.
diagnosis: The clearCart method drops only the first item using slice(1) instead of setting items to an empty array.

title: Cart total calculation ignores item quantities
description: When items have quantity > 1, the total sums item prices without multiplying by quantity.

defect.fixedContent: total: () => get().items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity, 0),

diagnosis: The total method sums item.price instead of item.price * item.quantity in the reduce accumulator.

title: Navbar cart counter shows number of unique items instead of total quantity
description: Adding multiple quantities of items shows the unique item count in the navbar header instead of the total unit count.

defect.fixedContent: const itemCount = items.reduce((n, i) => n + i.quantity, 0);

diagnosis: The NavBar component uses items.length (unique line items) instead of summing the item quantities.

title: Async promo code application race condition drops concurrent cart updates
description: When an item is added while asynchronous promo code validation is in flight, the promo resolution overwrites cart items with a stale pre-await snapshot, dropping newly added items.
diagnosis: The applyPromoCode method captures a stale snapshot of get().items prior to the async validation delay, overwriting state.items upon resolution and losing concurrent items added during the network delay.

title: Free shipping threshold defect coordinated across store calculation and Cart component display
description: Free shipping threshold for orders >= $50 is not applied due to strict inequality in cartStore and hardcoded fee display in Cart component.
diagnosis: cartStore checks total > 50 strictly instead of >= 50 for free shipping, and Cart.tsx hardcodes $5.00 display instead of referencing shippingFee.
